name: CLEANSERS
source:
Death was routine – but not this time. It was someone we knew. A demon came, cruel and relentless, wanting my life. I refused. Yumi and I stood side by side. In the calm afterward, I realized what truly matters: keeping her safe.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=39847]Lemmasoft forum[/url]]
translation:
死亡是家常便饭——但这次不同了。这是我们认识的人。恶魔来了，残忍无情，想要我的命。我拒绝了。我和由美并肩站着。在随后的平静中，我意识到真正重要的是：保证她的安全。

[来自[url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?t=39847]Lemmasoft论坛[/url]]
